newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CRESPO HAT-TRICK KEEPS PARMA IN TOUCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CRESPO HAT-TRICK KEEPS PARMA IN TOUCH.

text.p: Argentine Hernan Crespo struck a hat-trick as second-placed Parma thrashed Vicenza 3-0 on Sunday to stay just four points adrift of serie A leaders Juventus.
With Parma breathing down their necks in the closest Italian title race for six years, Juve kept their nerve to win 2-0 at lowly Verona.

But the European Cup finalists needed goals in the last minute of each half, from Ciro Ferrara and Vladimir Jugovic respectively, as well as some superb goalkeeping from Italy's Angelo Peruzzi, to take all three-points.
With four matches remaining, Juventus have 59 points and Parma 55, with the two sides due to meet in Turin next Sunday.
UEFA Cup finalists Internazionale came from behind to win 2-1 at Sampdoria with two goals from Maurizio Ganz.
